$comment: The manifest of an adapter (design §4): the machine form of the role list in core/contracts/<axis>.md. The structure is a subset of JSON Schema (see tools/lib/profile.mjs); `x-roles` lists the roles of each axis with their kind, which `harness check adapters` holds the manifest to: a required role must be filled, a role of the list may be left out only when its kind is optional, and a role the contract does not know is an error.

axis.description: The axis the adapter is on.

name.description: The adapter name, also the name of its folder.

contract.description: The version of the contract the adapter fills.

description.description: One sentence on what the adapter is for.

firstSteps.description: What a project does once, by hand, after the bootstrap, that the adapter cannot do for it (a lock file that no tool writes without the network, for example). The bootstrap lists the steps of the selected adapters in its next steps, and the scaffolded stack file lists them.

permissionModes.description: For a runtime: the permission modes it offers, in its own words. `harness init` asks for the project's default mode of a flow's workers (the profile role `flows.permissions`) only when a selected runtime lists modes here; a runtime without the list is not asked about.

terms.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) of the words that belong to this adapter and must not appear in core; the CORE scan joins it with the term lists of the profile file.

roles.description: The roles the adapter fills: a role of the contract, and what fills it.

file.description: A file of the adapter that fills the role, relative to its folder.

module.description: The Node module of the adapter that holds the logic of the role, relative to its folder.

export.description: The function of that module (a logic role has a module and an export).

files.description: For the stack role "ignore-files": the files in which the formatter and the linters exclude paths. Each must exclude the vendored framework (`harness check scaffold`).

path.description: The ignore file, relative to the project root.

optional.description: True when the file may be missing (the project does not use that tool at its root).

pattern.description: A regular expression, with `<folder>` for the vendored folder, that a line of the file must match when the tool excludes paths with a setting of its own (a TOML file) and not with one pattern per line. Without it, a line `<folder>/` is expected.

example.description: With `pattern`: the line to add, with `<folder>`, which the scaffold check prints.

enforces.description: The rules of the entry file the adapter holds, and at which moment: early (the agent runtime, before the action), local (a Git hook) or remote (the host and CI). The generated core rows of the rule-to-check map are built from these declarations. A `condition` limits an entry to a host that protects its branches (host-protected) or one that cannot (host-unprotected).

rule.description: A rule id of the entry file.

partial.description: True when the mechanism holds only part of the rule; a rule held only by partial mechanisms is "partly" in the map.

templates.description: The template files the adapter provides, relative to its folder.

defaults.description: Values of the profile file that the adapter gives a new project (design §6): the bootstrap writes them where the answers leave a role empty, and the answers win.
